sources.note: equipment plan source (research grade: datasheet); size 515 x 389 x 213 mm (w x d x h); port and control positions are placeholders until measured

Meyer Sound LINA datasheet page read 2026-11-12: "W: 20.27 in (515 mm) x H: 8.38 in (213 mm) x D: 15.32 in (389 mm)", 43 lb (19.5 kg), "powerCON 20 input with loop output", XLR 3-pin female balanced input, XLR 3-pin male loop output, an optional XLR 5-pin for audio and RMS, AC 90-265 V, two 6.5 in LF and one 3 in compression driver, end frames with GuideALinks for 0 to 11 degrees splay, a vented multi-ply birch enclosure. Modelled: the XLR input, the XLR loop output and the powerCON input (the mains loop output and the optional 5-pin are not modelled). The page does not say where the connectors sit (rear assumed); the page names no handles and no plan taper, so the shape is a plain rounded box (radius 6 mm is our estimate). The `power` switch is the simulator power control the catalogue adds to every mains inlet, not a switch the page documents. Positions are guesses.
